textwithimage.text:
Intel Atom® E3900 (“Apollo Lake-I“)

The Embedded BoxPC MBox-VH-E39, powered by the Intel Atom® E3900 (Apollo Lake-I) processor series, offers FPGA engineers a compact and versatile solution for their embedded applications. With support for up to 8 GB of DDR3L memory and ultra-low power optimization, this system delivers efficiency without compromising performance.

Featuring high-speed I/O options, including 2x Gigabit Ethernet and 2x USB 3.0 ports, this BoxPC ensures rapid data transfer and connectivity. Its 2x Mini DisplayPort connectors enable the connection of two high-resolution monitors, enhancing visualization and multitasking capabilities.

For added security, TPM 1.2/2.0 support is available as an option, while preparedness for wireless connectivity expands networking possibilities. The system can withstand extended temperature ranges, making it suitable for challenging environments.

With a highly customizable sheet metal chassis, individual configurations are easily achievable, and it can be adapted for various use cases. The MBox-VH-E39's versatility extends from embedded server and gateway applications to entry-level PC systems, offering a robust, durable, and long-term availability solution.

Whether used as a desktop device or integrated into cabinets with DIN rail mounting, this BoxPC from Intel's trusted hardware partner provides FPGA engineers with a reliable platform for their embedded projects

text.text:
Features

  • FPGA-Compatible Processor: Intel Atom® x5/x7 E3900 (Apollo Lake-I) series processors provide compatibility and performance suitable for FPGA engineering applications.

  • High-Speed I/O: The system offers 2x Gigabit Ethernet and 2x USB 3.0 ports for efficient data transfer and connectivity.

  • Dual Monitor Support: With 2x Mini DisplayPort connectors, the BoxPC enables dual high-resolution monitor connections for enhanced visualization and multitasking.

  • Security Options: Optional TPM 1.2/2.0 support enhances security features, safeguarding sensitive data and applications.

  • Customizable Chassis: The highly customizable sheet metal chassis allows for tailored configurations, meeting specific requirements of FPGA engineering projects
